'''Vital articles''' is a list of subjects for which Wikipedia should have corresponding high-quality articles. It serves as a [[Special:Recentchangeslinked/Wikipedia:Vital articles|centralized watchlist]] to track the status of Wikipedia's most essential articles. This is one of eleven [[Wikipedia:Vital articles/Level/4|Level 4]] sub-lists of ten thousand articles and is currently under construction.

{{Wikipedia:Vital articles/Labels}}

This list is tailored to the English-language Wikipedia. There is also a [[m:List of articles every Wikipedia should have/Expanded|list of ten thousand articles]] considered vital to Wikipedias of all languages.

For more information on this list and the process for adding articles, please see the [[Wikipedia:Vital articles/Frequently Asked Questions|Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) page]].

'''Vital articles''' is a list of subjects for which Wikipedia should have corresponding high-quality articles. It serves as a [[Special:Recentchangeslinked/Wikipedia:Vital articles|centralized watchlist]] to track the status of Wikipedia's most essential articles. This is one of eleven [[Wikipedia:Vital articles/Level/4|Level 4]] sub-lists of ten thousand articles and is currently under construction.

{{Wikipedia:Vital articles/Labels}}

This list is tailored to the English-language Wikipedia. There is also a [[m:List of articles every Wikipedia should have/Expanded|list of ten thousand articles]] considered vital to Wikipedias of all languages.

For more information on this list and the process for adding articles, please see the [[Wikipedia:Vital articles/Frequently Asked Questions|Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) page]].
